NArithmeticUnfolding.lintegral_arithmetic_shell_unfold.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsMulLeftInvariant] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K) (e : Option ℕ)
  (F : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ENNReal) (hF : Measurable F) :
  ∫⁻ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
      ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K) e x) *
        F x ∂NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda =
    ∫⁻ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
      NArithmeticUnfolding.indentationDensity K y * ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y) *
        F ↑y ∂lambda

NArithmeticUnfolding.arithmetic_shell_measure.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsMulLeftInvariant] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K) (e : Option ℕ) :
  ((NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda).withDensity fun x =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K) e x)) =
    Measure.map QuotientGroup.mk
      (lambda.withDensity fun y =>
        NArithmeticUnfolding.indentationDensity K y * ENNReal.ofReal (NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y))

NArithmeticUnfolding.integrable_integral_arithmetic_shell.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsMulLeftInvariant] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K) (e : Option ℕ)
  (F : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hF : Integrable F (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda)) :
  Integrable
      (fun y => ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K y) * ↑(NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y) * F ↑y)
      lambda ∧
    ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
        ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K) e x) *
          F x ∂NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda =
      ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
        ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K y) * ↑(NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y) * F ↑y ∂lambda

NArithmeticUnfolding.finiteKernel_originalHaar_shell_trace.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K))
  [lambda.IsHaarMeasure] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K)
  (b : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), 0 < b x)
  (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E] (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  have c := (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda).haarScalarFactor mu;
  have k := DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A;
  have d := fun e y =>
    ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K y) * ↑(NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y) * k ↑y ↑y;
  0 < c ∧
    (∀ (e : Option ℕ), Integrable (d e) lambda) ∧
      (∀ (e : Option ℕ),
          ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), d e y ∂lambda =
            ↑↑c *
              ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K) e x) * k x x ∂mu) ∧
        HasSum (fun e => ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), d e y ∂lambda)
          (↑↑c * Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A))
